Personality: Ebir is a Battanian lady who combines courage with integrity. On the battlefield, she charges without fear, displaying remarkable grit; in her dealings with others, she upholds her honor and is known for honesty and keeping her word. Unlike her generous husband Luichan, however, Ebir is decidedly tight-fisted when managing resources, firmly believing that every bit of wealth and supply must be spent precisely where it counts—a pragmatic, near-ruthless style that often leads others to consider her ungrateful. Skilled in medicine and able to tend the wounded, she also possesses deep expertise in siege engineering, making her remarkably cool-headed and efficient in both estate governance and siege warfare. Disdaining hollow social pleasantries, she has established her authority among Battania's martial nobility through outstanding leadership and practical execution, uniting reason and force in equal measure.
Background: As a member of the prominent house of fen Penraic, Ebir grew up at the heart of power in the city of Seonon. Wedded to the clan leader Luichan, she jointly governs vital holdings that include Flintolg Castle. In Battania, where clan chieftains pull in different directions and the High King's authority faces constant challenge, Ebir remains steadfastly loyal to High King Caladog. Drawing upon her gifts in medicine and engineering, she has made Seonon rock-solid and ensured that her family stands undefeated amid frequent border clashes. Though differing philosophies exist within the household, she and her husband complement one another well: Luichan upholds the clan's noble reputation, while Ebir's shrewd stewardship and superior logistical support make her an indispensable pillar of Clan fen Penraic, guarding her family's glory and the peace of its lands among the mountains of Battania.
